Thanks for flagging this, Kyle — sorry for the friction.

I checked our outbound records: an invite was triggered at 15:58 UTC to kyle.donovan@primemetals.com but the delivery attempt shows "suppressed - complaint/suppression list" in our email provider logs. That typically means the address was previously flagged (hard bounce or spam complaint) and is blocked at send time.

Short-term options:
- Can you confirm an alternate contact email we can try?
- I can generate a manual activation link and paste it here (expires in 72 hours).
- Our ops team can remove the suppression if you confirm the address is active — this requires a quick verification and then we requeue the invite.

If you need the PO turned around urgently, use this manual activation link: https://app.coupa.com/supplier/activate?token=REDACTED (note: single-use).

I'll loop in Procurement Ops to investigate the suppression source and get the original address cleared.

Ben Carter
